question: Should existing `gitcrawl cloud publish` users move immediately to fail-closed complete-enrichment snapshots, or should strict completeness be opt-in during an upgrade window?
rationale: The implementation supports an escape hatch, but the new default can stop existing automated publication; choosing immediate enforcement versus a compatibility period is an operator-facing release decision that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Stage strict enforcement
options.body: Preserve compatible publication during a migration window and require an explicit strict mode until operators have hydrated archives and upgraded the remote service.

options.title: Adopt strict enforcement now
options.body: Keep the fail-closed default and ship it only with explicit upgrade, deployment-order, and recovery guidance backed by production-equivalent validation.

recommendation.title: Stage strict enforcement
recommendation.body: Preserve compatible publication during a migration window and require an explicit strict mode until operators have hydrated archives and upgraded the remote service.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing publisher, owns the coverage semantics being enforced, and authored this upgrade.
